JavaScript

(async () => {
  const selector =
    '[data-app-action-timeline-scroll][role="region"]';

  const rows = [];

  for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
    const el = document.querySelector(selector);

    if (!el) {
      rows.push({ step: i, error: 'Timeline missing' });
      break;
    }

    const before = Math.round(el.scrollTop);
    const target = Math.max(0, before - 350);

    el.scrollTop = target;

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 450));

    const current = document.querySelector(selector);

    rows.push({
      step: i,
      before,
      target,
      after: current ? Math.round(current.scrollTop) : null,
      maxScroll: current
        ? current.scrollHeight - current.clientHeight
        : null,
      turns: document.querySelectorAll('[data-turn-key]').length,
      sameElement: el === current
    });
  }

  console.table(rows);
})();
